description: This file defines structures, enums, and functions for parsing and handling Certificate Revocation Lists (CRLs) according to RFC 5280, including parsing DER-encoded CRL data, representing CRL versions, and checking revocation status of certificates.

classes.name: ParsedCrlTbsCertList
classes.description: Represents the parsed structure of a CRL's TBSCertList section, including version, issuer, update times, revoked certificates, and extensions.

methods.name: ParseCrlCertificateList
methods.description: Parses a DER-encoded CRL 'CertificateList' as specified by RFC 5280, extracting the TBSCertList, signature algorithm, and signature value.

methods.name: ParseCrlTbsCertList
methods.description: Parses a DER-encoded 'TBSCertList' from a CRL, filling a ParsedCrlTbsCertList structure.

methods.name: GetCRLStatusForCert
methods.description: Determines the revocation status of a certificate based on a CRL's revoked certificates list.

methods.name: CheckCRL
methods.description: Checks the revocation status of a certificate using a DER-encoded CRL, a validated certificate chain, and distribution point info.

methods.name: ParseIssuingDistributionPoint
methods.description: Parses a DER-encoded IssuingDistributionPoint extension value, extracting distribution point names and certificate type constraints.
